The '''Federated Teradoc Union''' was a remnant of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. The Federated Teradoc Union was formed by two [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] [[Kosh Teradoc|Kosh]] and [[Treuten Teradoc]], after [[Greater Maldrood|their]] own splinter [[Kosh Teradoc's empire|factions]] united due to Greater Maldrood being targeted by the various other Imperial groups as well as the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

Following the death of Treuten by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]], Kosh took control and continued to rule over the Federated Teradoc Union, however he did not go with [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] and the remnants of the Empire to establish a "[[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]" on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|very edges]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. However, the Federated Teradoc Union finally fell after Kosh was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by New Republic [[Wraith Squadron|operatives]] on [[Ryvester]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].

==History==
After the Imperial [[Battle of Endor/Legends|defeat]] at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] [[Kosh Teradoc|Kosh]] and [[Treuten Teradoc]] established themselves as independent [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]], with Kosh forging an [[Kosh Teradoc's empire|empire]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], while his brother Treuten oversaw the establishment of the [[Greater Maldrood]], a series of territories in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Though the two territories initially operated independently of one another, in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] Treuten was forced to call upon his brother for help after he became targeted by both Imperial and New Republic forces, and when Kosh successfully defended Treuten's holdings, the two siblings combined their territories to form the "Federated Teradoc Union."

The two Teradoc brothers continued to enlarge their empire, by expanding their borders toward each others territories, though their alliance was almost shattered after the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Leonia Tavira]] attempted to cause a rift in their relationship. Following the reemergence of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]&mdash;who had survived his [[Death/Legends|death]] at Endor by possessing a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] body&mdash;in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], the Teradocs pledged their combined forces to Palpatine's [[Dark Empire]]. Palpatine's [[Operation Shadow Hand|campaign]] was a failure and Treuten's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was left severely battered, and in the aftermath of the Palpatine restoration, Kosh ordered Treuten to retreat to the Deep Core with his fleet whilst Kosh attempted to defend their Mid Rim holdings in the Greater Maldrood.

In an attempt to prove his worth to his brother, Treuten launched a new campaign against the Teradoc Union's primary rival in the Deep Core, the [[Zero Command]] of [[Lord High Admiral]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]], with [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] leading Treuten's [[Crimson Command|fleet]] of [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]]. After Teradoc staged a [[Battle of Harrsk's fortress|raid]] on Harrsk's fleet, Harrsk retaliated and [[Battle of Teradoc's fortress|attacked]] Teradoc's own forces in the [[Hakassi system/Legends|Hakassi system]], though the battle was brought to a stalemate by the actions of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]].

After Daala subsequently failed to negotiate an alliance between Treuten and 12 other influential Deep Core warlords at [[Tsoss Beacon/Legends|Tsoss Beacon]], Daala executed Teradoc and all of the other warlords present, then seized control of their holdings to form a [[United Warlord Fleets|united Imperial force]] after talks on [[Imperial Reunification]] failed, leading to Kosh falling from grace while under the guise of Daala, the Federated Teradoc Union forces passed to [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] who joined the [[United Warlord Fleets]]. However after the [[Assault on Yavin 4|failed assault]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], Daala relinquished [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|full command]] to Pellaeon who left the Federated Teradoc Union and formed the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].

Despite the loss of his brother and their Deep Core holdings, Kosh took control and continued to rule over what remained of the Federated Teradoc Union and was not a party to Pellaeon's Imperial Remnant. However, the Teradoc Union finally crumbled after Kosh was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] [[Wraith Squadron|operatives]] on [[Ryvester]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].
